meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手进入受规则约束的工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要助手在长任务中严格执行预设规则
copy.tagline_en: Make the agent follow a strict set of rules for the rest of the task
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to enforce a rigid workflow on long, demanding AI interactions

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 会先宣告“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,然后以证据驱动方式工作:先定目标与验收标准,再为每个标准写失败测试,再实现,最后用真实操作验证并交付可证明的成果。
howto.when: 当你说出“ultrawork”或“ulw”时,该技能会被触发并接管。

say.note: 开启后Claude会先宣告模式并执行严格流程。

say.text: 用ulw模式调试这个bug,给出证据。
say.note: 它会按层级分类处理,并用真实操作验证。

say.text: 切换到ultrawork,按步骤完成任务。
say.note: Claude会先宣告开启,再按计划执行。

howto.what_en: After enable, Claude announces "ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!" and works evidence-driven: set goals & criteria, write failing tests, implement, verify via real ops, deliver proof.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains "ultrawork" or "ulw".

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and implement this feature.
say_en.note: Claude will start the mode and follow a strict process.

say_en.text: Debug this bug in ulw mode and provide evidence.
say_en.note: It will classify the tier and verify with real operations.

say_en.text: Switch to ultrawork and complete the task step by step.
say_en.note: Claude will announce the mode and execute the plan.
